title: Parallel review rounds: cancel the sibling on stop, per-role activity, name every lost role, keep both owner questions

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S117 later notes (2026-10-26): the reviewer and UI pass now run in parallel. (1) When one stops the slice, the sibling round is not cancelled. (2) The activity ring is shared; parallel rounds need one per role. (3) A lost pause names only one lost role. (4) When one role paused first, the sibling's owner question is dropped. (5) planRun now errors when relay-roles show fails; plan without a ui role instead.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Owner decisions 2026-10-27 (interactive questions). (4) Keep Pending single: store the sibling round's owner question on the run record as a queued list; after the first answer the run pauses again on the next queued question (persist it in the run file; old files without it still load). (5) planRun: when RelayRules fails, plan without a ui role (UI and spec-check rows treated as absent) and carry a note on the plan saying why; RecommendRoles failing stays an error. Items (1) to (3): cancel the sibling round when one stops the slice; one activity ring per role; a lost pause names every lost role. Re-anchor from the code after S117 (round.go:315 is the sibling-pause guard; engine.go:471 pause; runs.go:321 planRun). Tests first with the engine harness fakes. If the queued list touches the TUI Questions tab or an RPC shape, keep it minimal and say so in the report (UI pass runs then).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/engine ./internal/daemon; go vet; gofmt -l; slicer check; adj lint.
